verdict.rationale: Circle documents that qualified businesses can use a Circle Mint account to convert USD to and from USDC at no additional cost, and community users confirm at-par create/redeem. Gateway (a unified USDC balance across chains) and CPN (USDC settlement for fiat payouts) cover stablecoin-side movement and rebalancing. However, the pack has no end-to-end documentation of fiat↔stablecoin internal transfers through an API or dashboard, and Mint access is gated to qualified businesses. Missing for 10: documented Mint API or dashboard flows for fiat↔USDC conversion, internal fiat/stablecoin balance management and rebalancing, an end-to-end walkthrough, and hands-on corroboration.
